name: nav-link
description: One point of navigation. The three surfaces styled these three ways; the active treatment was different on each.

reducedMotion.$description: Motion removed, state kept. The declaration is per unit because a blanket `animation:none` can hide content that only an entrance animation reveals.

a11y.notes: aria-current takes a TOKEN, not a boolean: the correct value for navigation is "page". Passing `true` renders a bare `aria-current`, which is valid ARIA but weaker — screen readers announce "current page" for the token and only "current" for the bare form. The current page is marked by that attribute, never by colour alone. The 2.75rem minimum height keeps the target well above the 24px floor.
